links.comparator_used: Existing hospital and national organization online patient education materials (OPEMs)
links.outcome: Readability (average grade level across seven indices)
links.effect: ChatGPT-generated materials averaged a 6.8-grade level, versus an 8th-12th grade level for hospital OPEMs, and were more readable than all hospital and organization OPEMs
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated materials averaged a 6.8-grade level, demonstrating improved readability, especially with specialized prompting, compared to all hospital and organization OPEMs.
